headline: Harman Kardon’s classic, see-through SoundSticks 4 are half off
summary: Harman Kardon's iconic SoundSticks 4 speakers are currently on sale. The transparent, 'alien-looking' speakers are synonymous with early 2000s Macs. They are now available for half off their usual price, a significant deal.

headline: Bambu’s five-nozzle P3C isn’t quite the 3D printer I expected
summary: Bambu Lab introduced the new P3C, a five-nozzle 3D printer. It offers advanced features like on-the-fly material and color swapping. The P3C provides many high-end features at less than half the price of the H3C model.

headline: Uber, Nuro, and Lucid kick off fully driverless robotaxi testing
summary: Uber, Nuro, and Lucid have started fully driverless robotaxi testing. Public road testing is underway in the San Francisco Bay Area, without human safety drivers. This alliance marks Uber's aggressive return to autonomous ride-hailing.

headline: Google alternative Kagi launches an email service
summary: Kagi, known for its Google Search alternative, has launched Kagi Mail. The new email service aims to rival Gmail with a privacy-focused approach. Kagi Mail promises no surveillance, no ads, open standards, and no lock-in.

headline: GTA 6 Players Are Optimizing the Money Glitch to Within an Inch of Its Life to Make $100,000 in Just 10 Minutes
summary: GTA 6 players are exploiting an infinite money glitch to get rich quickly. New optimization strategies allow players to earn $100,000 in just 10 minutes. Players are becoming millionaires within hours, even early in the game.

headline: I Watched GTA 6's In-Game TV Shows For Hours, They're Absolutely Wild
summary: GTA 6 features wildly satirical in-game TV shows and cartoons. Titles like 'Barnyard Blue' and 'The Tyrone Show' showcase Rockstar's dark humor. The game's satire has reached unprecedented levels, captivating viewers for hours.

headline: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 Teaser Pretty Much Confirms Fifth Playable Faction — and the Appearance of a Would-Be Chaos God
summary: A new teaser for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 has been released. The trailer hints at a fifth playable faction joining the game. It also teases the appearance of a fan-favorite character and a potential Chaos God.

headline: Disney+ and Hulu Bundle Drops to $4.99/Month for Black Friday 2026
summary: The Disney+ and Hulu streaming bundle is available at a discounted price. For Black Friday 2026, the bundle drops to just $4.99 per month. This is a limited-time deal for the popular streaming services.

headline: Two arrested on suspicion of burglary at Prince and Princess of Wales's Norfolk home
summary: Two individuals have been arrested on suspicion of burglary. The alleged break-in occurred at the Prince and Princess of Wales's Norfolk home. The property is located on the royal Sandringham Estate.

headline: Cheers and applause as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia office
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang received a celebratory welcome upon returning to the office. His return followed reports of Trump brokering a deal. Staff at Nvidia headquarters reacted with cheers and applause.

headline: Huntley murderer handed new whole life jail term
summary: Triple killer Anthony Russell has been given a new whole life prison sentence. Russell admitted to murdering child killer Ian Huntley in Frankland Prison. This new sentence confirms he will remain incarcerated for life.

headline: Inquiry expected into Birmingham housing scheme 'exploitation' after BBC investigation
summary: An inquiry is anticipated into alleged exploitation in a Birmingham housing scheme. This follows a BBC investigation highlighting issues in Supported Exempt Accommodation. Over 34,000 people in Birmingham reside in such accommodations.
